title: Copy checking and site writes agree on supported social icon families
steps: Run the released JA Boxing copy checker fixtures and the link icon writer tests.
expect: A YouTube class supported by the evidenced font family passes copy checks and is written by the link writer.
A wrong replacement network, an unsupported network, another font family and mixed-family inference remain refused.
A repair finding gives the supported target class when it exists.
fence: Copy validation and link writing resolve glyphs from one shared font-family rule.
